rules.disposition: Any unsupported or unresolved proposition requires REVIEW rather than a final disposition.
rules.holding_support: A proposition referencing a listed holding authority may be supported when its claim is within the supplied authority proposition.
rules.missing_authority: A proposition referencing an authority absent from the closed-world record is unresolved, not disproved.
rules.overbreadth: A proposition expressly stating that a factual dispute automatically defeats pleading sufficiency is overbroad under the supplied holdings.

synthetic_fixture_notice: All authority identifiers, citations, and excerpts in this package are synthetic test fixtures.
